name: Saki
source:
An arms dealer who travels to various regions driving a black AM equipped with a high-capacity weapon. When encountered in war zones, she replenishes ammunition and trades weapons in exchange for items.

She is mysterious and not much is known about her, except for the fact that she is a woman. Since she mostly communicates through radio. She is cool and likes to play up on her mystery.  She can be cold towards people who don't know her true identity and does not like exchanging words with others. She can be a sexually carnivorous kuudere for the right person.

She loves to use shiso furitake.
